## Overview

Stonefist was the capital of the Kingdom of Stonefist, the Half-Orc kingdom of the Era of Foundation, and one of the six mortal kingdoms that thrived before the monster invasion. It was a rugged fortress capital -- the seat of a proud and martial people.

---

## History

### Founding (Year 3)
Stonefist was established as the capital of the Half-Orc kingdom in a rugged, defensible mountain region.

### The Fall
Like all six kingdoms, the Kingdom of Stonefist fell to the monster invasion during the Abominable End.

### Present Day
The ruins of Stonefist stand in monster-held territory. Half-Orc survivors carried its traditions to the First Alliance and the Last Stand.

---

## Geography

The exact location of Stonefist is to be defined when the continent map is finalized. It was carved into a rugged mountain region chosen for its defensibility.

---

## Visual Character

- **Architecture**: Massive unadorned stone construction carved from the living rock. Thick walls, wide doorways built for warriors in full armor, and training grounds cut into the mountainside.
- **Landscape**: A stronghold built to endure -- no ornamentation, only strength and purpose. War banners of faded leather and iron hang from every gate.
- **Atmosphere**: Proud, disciplined, and fierce. War drums beat at dawn and dusk. There is laughter too -- loud, booming laughter -- but it is the laughter of warriors who have earned their rest.

---

## Legacy

Stonefist's legacy is the half-orc pride that survived the invasion, the discrimination, and the blame of Vorn. The warriors who escaped the city's fall became the backbone of the First Alliance's shock troops. Their descendants still carry the weight of a prejudice that their ancestors never earned.
